description: This file manages tag and tag group modals, including setup, validation, and event handling for adding, editing, and associating tags within a web application's UI.

methods.name: setupCheckExistingName
methods.description: Sets up input validation to check if a name already exists among tags or tag groups.

methods.name: setEditTgModal
methods.description: Prepares the edit tag group modal with data attributes and validation.

methods.name: setAtgModal
methods.description: Prepares the add-to-group modal with selected tag data.
